screenshot.note: Screenshot of Tabel 33 sent by the user on 2026-11-16; values typed from it. The filed Neraca PDF ends at Tabel 32, so the original document should be filed when available.

notes: Values were typed from an image; every row is checked against its printed totals and every column against TOTAL INDONESIA, and the national row against Tabel 31 of the Neraca PDF.
Provinces not in the table (15 of 38) have no coal resource or reserve data in the Neraca; they have no row here.
Reserves are a stock in the ground, not annual production; the Neraca gives national production only (836.12 million tonnes, Tabel 31, from Pusdatin ESDM December 2023).
The image mixes separators in a few cells ('1,417,40', '12,376,75', '36,268.91', '5,155,77'); they are read as the numbers shown.
Corrected cell, Aceh resource_measured: printed 362.23, corrected to 326.23 (the row total and the column total both require it)
Corrected cell, Papua Barat resource_total: printed 19.9, corrected to 18.9 (the row total and the column total both require it)

checks.cross_source: TOTAL INDONESIA equals Neraca PDF Tabel 31 for resources (inferred, indicated, measured, total) and reserves (probable, proven, total)

format.missing: a missing row means the source has no value; no placeholder values are written
format.layout: one value per row: key columns, then status, then value

status: final, or no marker in the source
